repo_truth: Fresh discovery reviewer /root/hcm_2_4_p2s_review replayed subject sha256:fed0f1b588828d9bc21b4fa52baeb686ca125e25dd11365f02d2318f1e2d48a1 and returned three P2 findings: store-only errors admitted on non-store observations, out-of-range transaction sequences admitted in refs, and incomplete executable proof behind the proof matrix. One consolidated in-scope remediation now makes store/non-store errors disjoint, bounds transaction refs to zero-padded 0001 through 4096 with N-1 vectors, and expands the proof to 15/15 with every distinct nested required key, a frozen 197-row semantic keyword inventory, operational pattern/enum negatives, 2592000/2592001 validity, exact count/byte/long-name/arbitrary-suffix early-termination vectors, and executable production-registration absence. Eight schemas meta-validate, registry preservation passes 6/6, fmt/diff checks pass, and no path outside the original P2S selector plus its immutable dispatch changed.
allowed_scope: Read-only, different-fresh, delta-focused closure review of the exact 12-path remediated subject.
Verify closure of all three named discovery findings and detect only defects directly caused or unmasked by this remediation.
Replay the full manifest, focused tests, schema meta-validation, evaluator definition fingerprint, and counterexample negatives.
Read the complete amendment and original immutable discovery dispatch as authority and finding context.
Return P1/P2 closure findings or a clean verdict with exact P3/P4 disposition.
non_goals: No edits, formatting, staging, commit, push, handoff, ledger write, dispatch creation, or delegation.
No reopened broad discovery outside the three remediated findings and directly caused or unmasked effects.
No P2A, production adapter, P2P, P2R, P2I, P2V, P4, P6, Phase 2 exit, registration, or runtime implementation.
Do not touch the eight unrelated pre-existing modified paths.
tasks: Verify the closure dispatch and exact remediated subject fingerprint.
Reproduce the original non-store/store counterexamples and confirm every cross-kind store-only error is refused.
Verify transaction-ref grammar accepts only exact zero-padded 1 through 4096 values and that N-1 correspondence is frozen semantically.

Audit the expanded proof for all distinct nested required keys, every semantic keyword, operational regex/enum negatives, validity boundaries, count/byte/early-termination vectors, and registration absence.
Run 15/15 P2S tests, 6/6 registry preservation, meta-validation, fmt, and diff checks.
Return findings first with exact file/line, violated contract, causal relation, smallest remediation, and missing verification.
contracts_and_gates: All three discovery P2 findings must be demonstrably closed without broadening the selected P2S path or behavior boundary.
No store-only error may validate on a non-store observation, and no non-store error may validate on the store row.
Transaction refs must encode only 0001 through 4096 and semantic vectors must bind a successor to N-1.
The proof record must not claim coverage absent from executable tests.
No valid P1/P2 may remain before the parent commits P2S or begins P2A.
P3/P4 advisories may remain clean only with exact inventory or explicit disposition under 09.
stop_conditions: Return blocked if the remediated manifest cannot replay or a named finding cannot be rechecked.
Report rather than repair any finding.
Stop rather than infer broader registration, runtime, dependency, unsafe-code, or packet authority.
